conceptZh: 豆：豆子；兔子魔術師從帽子變出豆漿卻失手，豆子和豆莢拔河拉出豆字。
object: a cartoon magician rabbit in a top hat, a pod of round soybeans, and a pitcher of soy milk
morph: rabbit and a stubborn bean pod pull opposite ends of a vine until the beans pop into the strokes of 豆
creativeAngle: 兔子魔術師想從帽子裡變出豆漿，卻變出一條豆莢藤；豆子往另一邊跑，兩邊拔河，彈回來剛好排成豆字。
promptEn: An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip on a solid pale cream-pink backdrop. Cast: a cartoon magician rabbit in a tall purple top hat and a star-tipped wand, whose tricks always misfire in a harmless, funnier way, plus a plump green bean pod on a vine with tiny round beans that wiggle. The only text on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 豆, drawn in saturated warm-brown strokes with a soft golden edge, ending centered, uncropped, about 70 percent of frame height with margins. 0.0-1.5s: the rabbit sweeps off his hat with a flourish, taps it with the wand, and pulls out a long green vine instead of the pitcher he was aiming for; he blinks at it. The first narrated 豆 lands as a first fat bean rolls out of the hat and bounces on the floor. 1.5-3.5s: the other end of the vine is wrapped around the pod, which grips the floor; tug-of-war begins, the rabbit leans back with his ears streaming and the pod digs in like a stubborn mule, round beans rattling out one after another, dancing around the rabbit's feet. The second narrated 豆 lands as the vine snaps, the beans fly together, and spring into the strokes of 豆 with a soft bonk. 3.5-5.0s: the rabbit tumbles backward into his own hat with only his feet visible, then pops up with a milk moustache after the pitcher he did mean to conjure finally drops from the sky in a gentle splash. As the word 豆漿 is spoken, the rabbit pours a glass of warm white soy milk into a small cup, steam curling up, and a tiny bean wearing a paper hat waves from the cup's rim. 5.0-8.0s: the glyph is perfectly still and readable for the last 3 seconds while the rabbit, to one side, sips his soy milk with his pinky out, takes a bow, and the bean gives a happy wiggle. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, clear tones, no erhua, reading exactly these syllables: 豆、豆、豆漿 (ㄉㄡˋ、ㄉㄡˋ、ㄉㄡˋ ㄐㄧㄤ). The character twice with a short pause, then the word once, then stop. The word is audio only. No background music, no extra speech, no subtitles or flashing effects; stylized cartoon animals and toys only, no real people.

conceptZh: 小外星人開著飛碟追一顆逃跑的豆子，牽引光束一直抓錯東西還把自己吸起來，最後飛碟肚皮著地大撞一下，木箱、箱蓋、兩顆豆子和滑痕剛好疊成「豆」字。
object: a runaway glossy brown toy bean, a square wooden bean crate with a flat lid, and the alien's toy flying saucer with its wobbly tractor beam
morph: the belly-flop crash flings the crate to center as 口, its lid up top as the first 一, two spilled beans flip out as the 丷 ticks, and the saucer's long skid stripe becomes the wide bottom 一, all locking into the solid brown glyph 豆
creativeAngle: 改走追逐路線：先前版本是兔子魔術師拔河，這次用小外星人的「抓錯東西」牽引光束當笑點主軸，連自己都吸起來，最後一次飛撲肚皮著地，撞擊本身把箱子、箱蓋、豆子和滑痕甩成豆字的四層結構，每個筆畫都有明確的物件來源；豆漿在念字時由光束吊進畫面，聲音與畫面同步。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip on a solid pale butter-yellow backdrop, nothing busy behind. Cast: a small green cartoon alien with one big curious eye and two bobbing antennae, piloting a chunky toy flying saucer whose wobbly blue tractor beam always grabs the wrong thing. The only text on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 豆, formed in saturated deep soybean-brown with a soft rounded edge, ending centered, uncropped, about 70 percent of frame height with even margins.

0.0-1.5s: A single glossy brown toy bean sits proudly on top of a square wooden bean crate. The alien hovers in from the left, points a tiny finger at the bean and fires the tractor beam. The beam lifts the crate lid instead; the bean hops off with a cheeky squeak and zips away across the floor. The first narrated 豆 lands exactly as the bean pops off and starts running.

1.5-3.0s: Chase. The bean zigzags across the frame in quick dashes; the saucer swoops after it in bigger and bigger loops, skidding wide round each turn. The beam grabs a small stool, drops it, then by mistake grabs the saucer itself: the alien is hoisted up out of his own seat for one frozen beat, dangling in his own blue beam, then plops back down with a bounce and shakes both fists at the bean.

3.0-4.5s: The big one. The alien backs up to the far right edge, revs the saucer with a wiggle, and launches in a flying leap toward the camera-left. The bean dodges. The saucer belly-flops flat onto the floor with a huge soft BONK, squashes, stretches and skids a long brown stripe across the bottom of the frame. The impact flings the crate dead center where it lands as the square 口, its lid flips up and lands as the top horizontal bar 一, two spilled beans somersault out and land as the two small ticks 丷 just below the box, and the skid stripe settles as the wide bottom bar 一. The second narrated 豆 lands as these four pieces lock together into the clean brown glyph 豆. The alien sits up dizzy with a happy spinning eye, the runaway bean perched smugly on his head.

4.5-8.0s: The glyph stays perfectly still and readable for the final 3.5 seconds. To the lower right, away from the strokes, the alien tries the beam one last time and finally catches the right thing: a tall glass of creamy white soy milk with a bendy straw floats gently in from off-screen. The word 豆漿 is spoken exactly as the glass arrives in his hands and he takes a long happy sip; the runaway bean dives off his head into the glass like a tiny pool and bobs up grinning.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin with clear tones and no erhua, reading exactly these syllables: 豆、豆、豆漿 (ㄉㄡˋ、ㄉㄡˋ、ㄉㄡˋ ㄐㄧㄤ). The character twice with a short pause, then the word once, then stop. The word is audio only. Soft cartoon whoosh, squeak and bonk sounds quieter than the voice, no music, no extra speech, no subtitles, no watermark, no flashing effects; stylized cartoon creature and toys only, no real people.
